siteEnv.title: Environment variables
siteEnv.intro: Given to the site at start-up: getenv('NAME') or $_SERVER['NAME'] in PHP, also in the cron jobs. The right place for API keys and passwords: never in the code, never in the public folder. Saving restarts the site (a few seconds).
siteEnv.nameInvalid: Letters, digits and _ (not starting with a digit)
siteEnv.unsecretValueRequired: Type a new value to make it visible (the stored one stays hidden)
siteEnv.importHint: Paste KEY=VALUE lines: existing names are replaced, the others added.
siteEnv.saved: Saved: the site restarts with the new variables
siteEnv.loadFailed: The variables could not be loaded
siteEnv.saveFailed: The variables could not be saved
siteEnv.noRight: Managing the variables needs the site settings right.
